entry.title: Social Summary: September 24, 2026
entry.summary: Bot Screen / Desktop Passthrough Launch — the dominant story of the batch: @NousResearch unveiled Bot Screen for Hermes Desktop (real-time streaming of any agent session) while Teknium announced live visual/interactive desktop passthrough for Hermes Agent (1,133 likes, ~173k views), backed by official docs and a community walkthrough from @tonbistudio. Sentiment was euphoric and long-awaited — Teknium's 'Finallllly!' and 'Much needed!' (~20k views) captured pent-up demand, with hype replies amplifying the launch thread. oh-my-hermes (OMH) & Jev Ecosystem — rlaope delivered the batch's strongest engagement (1,706 views) announcing OMH support for Jev-Skills and model routing, then open-sourced jeval (Jev evaluation/visualization) and an updated oh-my-hermes Plus, positioning OMH as the all-in-one plugin for AI-native hermes-agent power users. Usage Tips & Guidance — the official account shared a practical gem: use Hermes via iMessage with whichever model you prefer (~13k views), plus pointers to walkthrough content. Community Support & Maintenance — Teknium stayed visibly hands-on: disputing a cache complaint pending a reproducible issue, celebrating a quick 'fixed lol' resolution, and clarifying a discussed tool was built by the Nous/Hermes team, not Anthropic. Broader chatter — a lukewarm take praising Opus 5.5 while questioning Claude Code's agent experience, GitHub show-and-tell prompts, and short reaction posts rounding out a highly engaged, launch-driven week.
